title: X2Streaming-ASR: wait when uncertain, emit when ready for streaming ASR
abstract: arXiv:2609.08672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) for real-time voice agents and full-duplex dialogue must provide accurate partial transcripts with low commit latency. Existing systems commonly use a fixed chunk size, look-ahead, or target delay, or encourage emissions near estimated acoustic boundaries. These approaches do not directly optimize how much additional context to use at each output position under a single-pass, hard-commit constraint. We propose X2Streaming-ASR, which decomposes streaming recognition into when to commit and what to commit. Its three-stage training procedure first establishes streaming recognition ability, then warm-starts the commit policy with automatically probed trajectories, and finally refines the policy using character-level, segment-assigned group-relative rewards for recognition accuracy and latency. translated_abstract: 面向实时语音代理和全双工对话的流式自动语音识别（ASR）必须以低提交延迟提供准确的部分转录结果。现有系统通常使用固定的块大小、前瞻或目标延迟，或者鼓励在估计的声学边界附近进行输出。这些方法并未在单遍、硬提交约束下直接优化每个输出位置应使用多少额外上下文。我们提出X2Streaming-ASR，它将流式识别分解为“何时提交”和“提交什么”两个子问题。其三阶段训练流程首先建立流式识别能力，然后利用自动探测的轨迹对提交策略进行热启动，最后使用字符级的、按片段分配的组相对奖励，针对识别准确率和延迟对策略进行优化。在AISHELL-1/2/3和WenetSpeech数据集上，X2Streaming-ASR实现了平均字符级提交延迟为……
tldr: X2Streaming-ASR将流式语音识别分解为“何时提交”和“提交什么”两个子问题，通过建立流式识别能力、提交策略热启动、基于字符级组相对奖励优化的三阶段训练，在保证识别准确率的同时显著降低提交延迟。
en_tdlr: X2Streaming-ASR decomposes streaming ASR into "when to commit" and "what to commit," using a three-stage training procedure with character-level segment-assigned group-relative rewards to balance recognition accuracy and commit latency across AISHELL-1/2/3 and WenetSpeech.
